description: Tuples \(\bar a\in M^n\) and \(\bar b\in N^n\) in models of \(T\) have equal complete types if and only if some finite partial elementary map has domain exactly the range of \(\bar a\), range exactly the range of \(\bar b\), and sends every \(a_i\) to \(b_i\), including repeated coordinates and the empty tuple.
